description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter class 'DeviceAdapter' for displaying and managing a list of smart home devices in an Android TV application. It includes view holder setup, binding device data to UI elements, handling focus and key events for TV remote navigation, and visual styling based on device state.
external_files: R (resource identifiers, e.g., R.drawable.lightbulb_24, R.color.card_on_bg, R.layout.item_device_card)

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying smart home device cards with TV remote support, managing device toggle states, and focus animations.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter.DeviceViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class that manages UI binding, event handling, and focus effects for each device item in the list.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Device object to the view holder, sets up UI components, toggle logic, and focus/key event handlers.

methods.name: updateCardState
methods.description: Changes the visual appearance of the card based on whether the device is on or off.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for a device card and creates a DeviceViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a device at a specific position in the list to a view holder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of devices in the list.
